start.title: Try DMN Zeit
start.intro: The demo sets up a sample company of its own: a tax office with twelve people, bookings since January, open requests and findings under the German Working Hours Act.
start.roles: The demo opens in the employee role. “Switch role” leads on to team lead, HR and administration, and into the solo workspace of a freelancer with project time and invoices, no password needed.
start.note: All names and times are made up. The sample company is deleted after 24 hours, together with everything entered.
start.throttled: Too many demos were started from this connection in a short time.
start.full: The demo is full right now.
